source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = []
    for block_r in range(3):
        rows = []
        for r in range(n):
            src_r = n - 1 - r if block_r in (0, 2) else r
            row = []
            for block_c in range(3):
                vals = list(grid[src_r])
                if block_c in (0, 2):
                    vals.reverse()
                row.extend(vals)
            rows.append(row)
        out.extend(rows)
    return out
'''
